title: Thinking on AI, the Future of Work, and the Commoditization of High(er) Skilled Labor
summary: Kahran and Divya look at how DALL-E, GPT-3, voice synthesis and stable diffusion are doing to white-collar work what Uber and Mechanical Turk did to other industries — chopping highly skilled labor into small dispersible chunks. They also wander into how endless slightly-satisfying entertainment has stretched our attention, and whether AI-supported reality TV is on the horizon.
topics: ai and the future of work
